name: chat-model-timeout-config
title: Chat model timeout/retry configurable for long structured-output requests
description: Root cause confirmed for draft (续写) ModelAPIError 'Request timed out' after ~181s: llm/models.py hardcodes _REQUEST_TIMEOUT=60.0 with max_retries=2, so a non-streaming structured-output draft that takes >60s per attempt burns 3x60s and fails. Make chat model timeout/retry Settings-configurable with larger defaults and avoid useless retries on long structured-output calls; keep embeddings config in sync per spec.
creator: lenny
